title: GL Dining Restaurant Website
description: Team-built website for Blu and The Library, two locally owned restaurants in Norman, Oklahoma.
details: Our team met with the owners to understand what makes their restaurants community gathering spaces. The site works like an online brochure: menus with allergy guidance, hours, a private-event inquiry form, and a mobile-friendly job application. I created individual wireframes and a UI/UX concept focused on a cozy feel with minimal scrolling.

title: Personal Portfolio Website
description: This responsive multi-page portfolio, with projects loaded dynamically from a JSON file.
details: Built with Bootstrap's grid and components plus a custom stylesheet. JavaScript uses fetch() to load project data, generates the project cards, and powers category filtering, keyword search, project detail modals, and a saved light/dark theme.

title: C# Business Console Applications
description: Four console programs covering shipping costs, restaurant orders, account validation, and product search.
details: A single solution containing a shipping calculator, a restaurant order system, an account registration validator, and a product search and filter tool. The assignment practiced conditionals, loops, input validation, and collections in C#.

title: Reddit AI Discourse Text Mining
description: Collected and analyzed Reddit discussions about artificial intelligence to surface recurring themes.
details: I first planned to analyze YouTube comments, but switched to Reddit after the YouTube comment importer broke due to API changes. The corpus is drawn from AI-focused subreddits and analyzed in R with tidytext to identify common words and themes.

title: Apple Product Tweet Analysis
description: Word frequency analysis of X (Twitter) posts mentioning Apple's iPhone and iPad.
details: Using a NodeXL-gathered corpus (reposts excluded), I tokenized posts, removed URLs, punctuation, and stopwords, then reported and interpreted the most frequent terms.

title: EMR/EHR Implementation Plan
description: Project plan for implementing an electronic medical records system at a family medicine clinic.
details: As part of a three-person team, I helped plan the Riverside Family Medicine EMR/EHR implementation, covering scope, schedule, risks, and stakeholders, and presented the final plan to the project sponsor.

title: AI and Employee Autonomy (Master's Thesis)
description: Ongoing thesis research on how AI tools affect employees' sense of autonomy at work.
details: Grounded in self-determination theory, this research explores how AI affects the fulfillment of employees' need for autonomy, and how informational autonomy relates to learning, job satisfaction, and turnover intentions. Expected completion: May 2027.
